description: Discover Amazon's own search-autocomplete keyword suggestions for one or more seed keywords.

customSuffixes.description: Suffixes to append to each keyword, e.g. `for men`, `waterproof`, `cheap`. Only used when expandWith is `customSuffixes`.
customSuffixes.title: Custom suffixes (expandWith=customSuffixes)

dedupe.description: Skip a suggestion value if it was already emitted earlier in this run (recommended -- expansion and recursion frequently rediscover the same suggestion).
dedupe.title: Deduplicate suggestions

expandWith.description: Harvest more suggestions per keyword by re-querying with an appended suffix (Amazon caps each raw response at ~10 suggestions).
expandWith.title: Expand each query with

includeSeed.description: Also emit one record per seed keyword itself (suggestionType `SEED`), in addition to Amazon's suggestions.
includeSeed.title: Include seed keyword as its own record

keywords.description: One or more seed keywords/phrases to expand into Amazon autocomplete suggestions.
keywords.title: Seed keywords

marketplace.description: Which Amazon marketplace's autocomplete API to query.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

maxDepth.description: Recursively re-query newly discovered suggestions as fresh seeds, up to this many levels deep (0 = only query the original seed keywords).
maxDepth.title: Max recursion depth

maxSuggestions.description: Hard cap on total suggestion records emitted in this run.
maxSuggestions.title: Max suggestions

title: Amazon Keyword Suggestions Scraper Input
